title: ～ようとしない
shortExplanation: Not showing any sign or intention to do something.
longExplanation: The ～ようとしない grammar point indicates that someone is not showing any sign or intention of doing an action. It is used to express a refusal or unwillingness to do something. It is formed by using the volitional form of a verb followed by としない.

examples.jp: 彼は勉強しようとしない。
examples.romaji: Kare wa benkyou shiyou to shinai.
examples.en: He doesn't show any sign of trying to study.

examples.jp: 彼女は謝ろうとしない。
examples.en: She doesn't show any intention of apologizing.

examples.jp: 息子は部屋を片付けようとしない。
examples.romaji: Musuko wa heya wo katazuke you to shinai.
examples.en: My son doesn't show any intention of cleaning his room.

examples.jp: 犬は散歩に行こうとしない。
examples.romaji: Inu wa sanpo ni ikou to shinai.
examples.en: The dog doesn't show any sign of wanting to go for a walk.
